# Getting Started

## Install sqlpipe

Run this command to download and install sqlpipe:

```
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

The installer puts the binary in `/usr/local/bin`. Run `sqlpipe --version` to make sure the installation is correct.

## Configure sqlpipe

Create a file named `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project directory. This file tells sqlpipe how to connect to your database and where to send data.

A minimum configuration has these properties:

- `source`: The database connection string
- `destination`: The output target (file path or endpoint)
- `query`: The SQL statement to run

Refer to the Configuration Reference for all available options.

## Run your first pipeline

After you save your configuration file, run this command:

```
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

sqlpipe connects to your database, runs the query, and sends the results to your destination. If there is an error, sqlpipe shows a message with the cause and a solution.
